name: claude-usage-dashboard
description: Compact Windows desktop widget showing usage of multiple Claude accounts
author: Pickigo

scripts.build:ts: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json
scripts.compile: npm run build:ts && npm run copy:static
scripts.dev: npm run compile && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron .
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run compile && electron-builder --win
